what: The thick SVG road is drawn without a curve up to the height where the 80% line of the screen touches (found as the cumulative max height of 257 road points), and a stop placed at its data-at share on the road gets is-in once the line passes it (when rewinding it turns off only after the screen goes 2% further). Each stop gets parallax by its distance from screen center at .06·.09·.12 speeds (.3x on phone). When the road is 93% drawn and the end position comes within .9 of the screen, the plate gets is-blown — the ending scene (explosion · sparks) is turned on in css, and data-erupt stops turn on with it. With lerp, the drawing chases the scroll by that share (about road .12)

options.line: Share of screen height the drawing tip follows, default .8
options.by: line (default — when the station crosses that line) or path (when the path is drawn up to the station’s share of its length)
options.lerp: Amount the image chases the scroll (per frame), default 0 (immediate)
options.end: Share of the image that lights the ending scene, default .93
options.[data-fx-part=path]: Path to draw (pathLength="1"). If wide and narrow versions are both placed, the visible one is used
options.[data-fx-part=stop]: Station: with data-at (path share 0–1) it moves to that spot, with data-fixed it stays where the using side put it, data-speed sets the parallax speed, and data-erupt turns it on together with the final scene

use:
Card
Footer image
